layout: Single wide terminal window (macOS 3-dot title bar, window title 'root@geeksforgeeks:/' with the '/' in orange) centered on dark background with orange glowing circuit traces. No title text. ls output: dirs in blue, lib* in teal, 'swapfile' in white (regular file), 'tmp' highlighted with green background (sticky dir). Prompt 'root@geeksforgeeks:/#' in orange, cursor block at end.

blocks.title: root@geeksforgeeks:/
blocks.info: colors: blue = directories (bin, dev, mnt, root, snap, sys, var, boot, etc, lost+found, opt, run, srv, cdrom, home, media, proc, sbin, usr); teal = lib, libx32, lib32, lib64 (symlinks); white = swapfile; tmp = green highlight box. Empty strings mark blank cells.
